开关虽已合上，电子开关也允许导通，灯的回线却断了。控制信息不能跨过断口给灯供能。: The supply switch is closed and the electronic switch allows conduction, but the lamp return is broken. Control information cannot supply energy across the gap.

供电开关接上了，回线也完整，灯回路导通。电池持续供能，灯把电能变成光和热。: The supply switch is closed and the return is intact, so the lamp loop conducts. The battery supplies energy, which the lamp turns into light and heat.

感光器附近等于或亮于设定分界，反转后的规则要求点灯。相同器件也能按另一条规则工作: Light near the sensor is at or above the boundary, so the reversed rule requests light. The same components can follow a different rule.
感光器附近等于或亮于设定分界，夜灯规则要求不亮。电池与回线仍在，电子开关让灯支路: Light near the sensor is at or above the boundary, so the nightlight rule requests no light. The battery and return remain; the electronic switch stops conduction in the lamp branch.

电池、机械开关、灯和回线组成灯回路。打开的接点或断开的回线都会让灯不亮。: The battery, mechanical switch, lamp and return form the lamp circuit. Open contacts or a broken return prevent the lamp from lighting.

它报告自己附近的亮暗，不知道你是谁，也不凭自己看懂整个房间。: It reports nearby light levels. It does not know who you are or understand the whole room by itself.

Our automatic nightlight is one example: sense light → follow a control rule → turn the lamp on or off. Following a fixed rule does not make it AI.
